experiment: P10 fast greedy attribution of historical-experimental versus P9 policy factors
scope: development-only mechanism attribution; no production imports, qualification changes or score projection
case_status: all cases were consumed by prior archive or bounded-response experiments; none is a new holdout

cases.persona_axis: all four P9 resampled families at repetition 901 for centered_independent and negative_persona_aligned; already consumed development seeds

response_estimator.pooled: untried targets use the shrinkage mean of public first responses, matching historical experimental behavior
response_estimator.fixed: untried targets retain the fixed 12.75 first-slot population prior; tried targets use their own public response
response_estimator.persona_sample_prior: experimental sample-inspired first-slot values peace 20.25, neutral 15 and violent 3; a target's own observed response overrides the prior; this is a hypothesis, not an official rule

structure_mode.unrestricted: all legal strictly positive predicted-gain shield/cut actions remain candidates
structure_mode.direction_roi: apply public sign/persona direction and communication-ROI filters while forcing the positive-graph gate open
structure_mode.full_gate: apply direction/ROI filters and the actual positive-graph structure closure

narrow_cut_arm: start from fixed__full_gate and restore only legal positive-gain cuts whose two public endpoints both have w < 0 and persona != peace; all other filtered structure actions remain excluded
hybrid_definition: use pooled responses when the positive-graph gate is closed and fixed responses otherwise, matching the current public-greedy base planner

interpretation.response_factor: normally changes scores and ordering without directly enumerating a different structure set; at an opinion bound it may remove zero-gain communication candidates
interpretation.direction_roi_factor: can remove shield/cut candidates and therefore changes the available structural action set
interpretation.positive_graph_factor: can remove every shield/cut candidate when the public positive-graph condition closes

required_logs: ordered actions, budgets, public responses and final score
per-decision selected action and candidate IDs partitioned by comm/cut/shield
candidate additions/removals by action kind between paired arms
first selected-action divergence and whether it is ranking-only or candidate-set-changing
source, runner and seed hashes; action failures and resource limits
analysis: report each case and each factor contrast without exclusions
pooling contrast within each fixed structure mode
persona-prior versus fixed-prior contrast within each fixed structure mode and separately on persona-aligned versus independent consumed seeds
direction/ROI contrast against unrestricted within each fixed response estimator
positive-gate contrast against direction/ROI within each fixed response estimator
do not promote a production change from these consumed cases
